_comment: Catalog shown in Blue Media Writer. `url` (optional) is a direct https download of the image; `pageUrl` is the project's official download page, opened when no stable direct link exists. `checksumUrl` (optional) points to a sha256sum file. Users can add their own entries in ~/.config/Blue-Environment/media-images.json (same format, same ids override).
